members.description:
Connect the socket to `port` on `host`. If `host` is not provided, it defaults to
`'localhost'`. `onconnect` is called when the connection is established.

params.name: port
params.description: The port to connect to.

params.name: host
params.description: The host to connect to; defaults to `'localhost'`.

params.name: opts
params.description:
Connection options; if `host` is a hostname it is resolved with `opts.lookup`,
which defaults to `dns.lookup` from `bare-dns`.

params.name: onconnect
params.description: Called when the connection is established.

throws.condition: the socket is already connecting or connected.
`port` is not an integer between 0 and 65535.

(default `dns.lookup`) resolves `host` when it is a hostname.

exports.name: TCPServerOptions
signatures:
interface TCPServerOptions {
  allowHalfOpen?: boolean
  keepAlive?: boolean | number
  keepAliveInitialDelay?: number
  maxConnections?: number
  noDelay?: boolean
  pauseOnConnect?: boolean
  readBufferSize?: number
}
exports.description: Options for a TCP server, applied to each incoming socket.

members.name: allowHalfOpen
members.description:
Keep the writable side of each incoming socket open after the readable side ends. Defaults to
`true`.

members.name: keepAlive
members.description: Enable keep-alive on each incoming socket. Defaults to `false`.

members.name: keepAliveInitialDelay
members.description: The initial delay in milliseconds before the first keep-alive probe is sent. Defaults to `0`.

members.name: maxConnections
members.description:
The maximum number of concurrent connections; connections beyond it are dropped. Defaults to
`Infinity`.

members.name: noDelay
members.description:
Send data immediately without buffering, disabling Nagle's algorithm, on each incoming socket.
Defaults to `false`.

members.name: pauseOnConnect
members.description: Pause each incoming socket on connection instead of opening it eagerly. Defaults to `false`.

members.name: readBufferSize
members.description: Size, in bytes, of each incoming socket's read buffer. Defaults to `65536`.
